migration_flags.description: discount (Float) field added to product.supplierinfo in v17+; drives price_discounted computed field; not present in v16
migration_flags.action: Verify source v16 schema; add discount column in migration script if upgrading from v16

migration_flags.description: price_discounted is a new computed field (price * UoM_factor * (1 - discount/100)); _select_seller now sorts by this instead of raw price
migration_flags.action: No DB migration needed (computed+not-stored); verify no custom code depends on price-only sort

migration_flags.description: _select_seller gains 'ordered_by' parameter defaulting to 'price_discounted'; callers passing keyword args by position may break
migration_flags.action: Audit all custom code calling _select_seller; ensure keyword args used

migration_flags.description: purchase.order.line gains selected_seller_id (computed Many2one to product.supplierinfo); acts as bridge for price/date computation
migration_flags.action: No DB column (not stored); no migration needed

migration_flags.description: purchase.order.line gains technical_price_unit (Float); guards against overwriting manually-set prices; new column
migration_flags.action: Add column in migration; backfill with price_unit value for existing PO lines

migration_flags.description: In v16/v17 price_unit, date_planned, and name were computed by separate methods; merged into one in v19
migration_flags.action: Remove any custom overrides of the old separate compute methods; override the merged method instead

migration_flags.description: product.supplierinfo.product_uom_id is now a computed+stored field defaulting to product UoM; previously a simple stored field
migration_flags.action: Verify existing records have product_uom_id populated; recompute if migrating from v16

migration_flags.description: product.supplierinfo has no 'name' field in v19; vendor identity is split into product_name and product_code; check if v16 had a name field
migration_flags.action: Confirm v16 schema; if 'name' was used map to product_name or product_code in data migration

key_findings.primary_sort: sequence ASC, min_qty DESC, price ASC, id ASC
key_findings.selection_algorithm: _select_seller on product.product: filter by date/partner/qty/variant, group by partner, sort by price_discounted converted to company currency
key_findings.currency_conversion: seller.currency_id._convert to PO currency_id at order date; applied in _compute_price_unit_and_date_planned_and_name and _prepare_purchase_order_line
key_findings.multi_company: company_id on supplierinfo + check_company on partner_id; purchase override reads company from params order_id
key_findings.discount_in_v19: discount field present; price_discounted = price * uom_factor * (1 - discount/100); discount propagated to PO line
key_findings.variant_level: product_id field enables variant-specific pricing; None means template-level (all variants)
key_findings.no_select_seller_on_template: _select_seller lives on product.product, not product.template; template seller_ids has depends_context company
